name: 100 días para enamorarnos
description: Two couples who struggle to be near each other decide to give another chance for each other, 100 days for them to fall back in love.

videos.title: Couple in crisis
videos.overview: Remedios experiences an awkward reunion during a doctor visit. Connie's mounting anger at her husband leads to an explosive misunderstanding at a party.

videos.title: The unusual agreement
videos.overview: Connie and Plutarco set rules for their separation. An overheard phone call infuriates Remedios. Luis goes on a work trip — or so he tells Jimena.

videos.title: Plutarco releases his freedom
videos.overview: Luis struggles to juggle both of his lives. Emiliano takes Plutarco to a bar to reintroduce him to the singles scene. Pablo pursues his new crush.

videos.title: In glory
videos.overview: Luis learns both of his women are simultaneously racing to the hospital. Remedios is summoned to her boss's office to discuss the open house incident.

videos.title: Now it's Constanza turn
videos.overview: Ale hides a secret, and gets mixed signals from Lucia. A dating app connects Connie with a TV journalist. Plutarco bumps — literally — into trouble.

videos.title: Tough competition
videos.overview: Roger offers Connie insider info on the Catalina Jones case. Remedios drops a bombshell on Emiliano. Remedios finally gets Ale to confide in her.

videos.title: Tequila effect
videos.overview: Connie pays a visit to Remedios' former boss, and later gets an unexpected call to fulfill a parental duty after indulging in too much tequila.

videos.title: Sol's bet
videos.overview: Max gives a crash course on fatherhood to Emiliano, who unexpectedly runs into Ale. Surprise guests make Jimena's birthday party a tense one.

videos.title: The hill of love
videos.overview: Daniel insists on staying at the diner to see who picks up Sol. Remedios drags Connie to a speed dating event, where she talks her way into a new job.

videos.title: The empire of males
videos.overview: Fernando apologizes to Pablo. Ale has a study date at home with Lucia while Daniel has one with Sol at the penthouse. Jimena finds a suspicious receipt.

videos.title: Times change
videos.overview: Luis has some explaining to do. Remedios confronts Lucia's gossiping mom, while Ale and Daniel hunt down Lucia and her boyfriend. Connie gets stood up.

videos.title: Cyber love
videos.overview: Plutarco creates a fake Flirter profile to spy on his wife. Remedios and Pablo present their decorating ideas to Bruno. Connie meets up with Fausto.

videos.title: Cobweb of lies
videos.overview: Ale demands an explanation from Remedios, Max and Emiliano. Sol drops by the penthouse to visit Daniel. Pablo challenges Fernando to be brave.

videos.title: Cheater in sight
videos.overview: Aurora and her son arrive in their new hometown of Houston. Sol refuses to stop seeing Plutarco. Emiliano makes a slip of the tongue with Lorena.

videos.title: Whim
videos.overview: Remedios fill in for her dad at his job, where she runs into another ex. At the talent show, Connie is reminded of what a great father Plutarco is.

videos.title: From love to madness
videos.overview: Emiliano arranges a romantic surprise for Remedios. A tearful Sol shows up on Connie's doorstep. Pablo and Fernando connect over an intimate dinner.

videos.title: Goodbye covenant
videos.overview: Connie and Plutarco start bending their separation rules. Sol shows up unexpectedly at the law firm. Fernando is asked by his ex-wife about Pablo.

videos.title: There is no coming back
videos.overview: Max worries about his upcoming gig. At school, Benjamin drops a bombshell on Daniel. Jimena calls her husband's employer to make a complaint.

videos.title: Heart impulses
videos.overview: Ale gives Lucia a gift. Remedios and Connie crash a PTA moms' event. Isabel invites Pablo to her house. Emiliano finds a surprise awaiting him at home.

videos.title: Crazy life in Miami
videos.overview: Connie takes Remedios with her to look for a new office in Miami, where they have a celebrity encounter. Ale and Lucia get to know each other better.

videos.title: Heads or tails
videos.overview: A challenge from Benjamin reveals Ale's remaining secret. Connie is sought out by a high-profile client, while her mom confides in Ramiro.

videos.title: The most difficult case
videos.overview: Remedios accidentally walks in on Ale getting dressed. Ale and Lucia skip school and go to the movies. Connie goes running with Lobo.

videos.title: The old seduction trick
videos.overview: Emiliano gets Ale to open up to him. Remedios meets Lobo's ex-wife. Luis decides to come clean. Lobo introduces Connie to his world.

videos.title: Lobo can handle everyone
videos.overview: Jimena insists on going with her husband to Chicago so they can attend the "funeral" together. Lobo shows his true colors to Remedios.

videos.title: Great match
videos.overview: Emiliano gives Ale advice on self-acceptance. Remedios tells Connie about the bathtub incident. Isabel visits Emiliano for a medical checkup.

videos.title: Fighting cocks
videos.overview: Aurora visits Jimena at the firm. While looking for his grandson at school, Pedro spots Fernando talking to Isabel. Lucia explores her feelings for Ale.

videos.title: Love triangle
videos.overview: To prevent Aurora from taking legal action, Luis pulls out the stops to win her back. Daniel falls for a new girl at school: Fernando's niece.

videos.title: Take and give me
videos.overview: A drunken Lobo tells Remedios a secret. While visiting with Jimena, Aurora spots a family portrait. Lobo's ex tells her side of the story to Remedios.

videos.title: Unforgetable party
videos.overview: Aurora asks Jimena how she and her husband met. Remedios arranges for Connie to meet Hilda. Daniel's party at Emiliano's loft gets out of control.

videos.title: Like a wolf to its prey
videos.overview: Aurora plays dumb but makes it as hard as possible for Luis to keep up his charade. Connie gives her husband the evidence she has against Lobo.

videos.title: Plutarco in the game
videos.overview: Lobo sues the firm. Emiliano gives his saved letters to Remedios, who finally reads them all. Aurora sets Luis up to receive the shock of his life.

videos.title: To the old times
videos.overview: After reading Emiliano's letters, Remedios shows up on his doorstep. Lucia tells Ale she now knows what she wants. Aurora gives Luis an ultimatum.

videos.title: Two mens for one date
videos.overview: Desperate to understand what's going on with her child, Remedios snoops around in Ale's room. Mariana reveals to Daniel why she had to move to Houston.

videos.title: The 100 days of Luis
videos.overview: A parent makes a complaint about Fernando. Luis tells Jimena they need to talk. Accompanied by Remedios and Emiliano, Ale goes to see a psychologist.

videos.title: The accomplices are partying
videos.overview: Ale tells Max about the visit to the psychologist. Daniel and Mariana grow closer. Aurora pays an unexpected visit to Luis' friends.

videos.title: Ended up with nothing
videos.overview: Connie calls Jimena to tell her what Luis has been hiding from her. Luis goes to Aurora's apartment, where a message from her awaits.

videos.title: The excuse
videos.overview: Connie fumes at her husband over the fake Flirter profile. Dario makes up an excuse to visit Jimena at her home. Pablo runs into an old flame.

videos.title: Life gives you surprises
videos.overview: Luis is cornered by his two women. Connie meets up with Fausto, who makes a surprising announcement. Ramiro overhears an upsetting conversation.

videos.title: Constanza goes for more
videos.overview: Luis visits the firm to see Jimena. Emiliano makes an appeal to Ramiro. Connie has a hot date with Roger, and things heat up between Daniel and Mariana.

videos.title: Trapped
videos.overview: Emiliano asks Isabel to return for an urgent follow-up appointment. Remedios starts her new job. Jimena decides to join forces with Aurora.

videos.title: I'm Alex
videos.overview: Benjamin harasses Remedios at the diner. Plutarco and his sons enjoy a day of fun with Gloria and Mariana. Ale invites Lucia to a support group meeting.

videos.title: Everyone's courage
videos.overview: Luis proposes a radical idea to Jimena and Aurora. In Fernando's class, Alex introduces himself. Remedios makes a decision about her future.

videos.title: The attack
videos.overview: Frida blurts out news about her father to Pablo. Alex becomes the target of a hate crime. Jimena and Aurora accept Luis' proposal — on one condition.

videos.title: No two without three
videos.overview: Plutarco asks Gloria if she's planning on having children. Alex tells the school coach he wants to play football. Isabel gets her biopsy results.

videos.title: Inopportune
videos.overview: Roger interviews Alex and his allies for a special news report. Luis unexpectedly drops by the family home, where both his children greet him.

videos.title: The fourth power
videos.overview: Pablo and Remedios are offered a business opportunity. A case file in Connie's office tempts Roger. Luis' kids get a chance to express their feelings.

videos.title: Scent of Hounds
videos.overview: Connie asks Roger if he stole information from the Quintero case file. Alex tries out for the football team. Emiliano asks Ramiro for a favor.

videos.title: A heart for two
videos.overview: Daniel enters a local DJ battle, where Lucia springs a surprise on Alex, and Mariana receives a terrifying message. Jimena gives Dario a booty call.

videos.title: A bomb about to explode
videos.overview: Alex uses the men's restroom at school. Connie attracts a female admirer. When Plutarco gets tied up at work, Gloria volunteers to watch Martin.

videos.title: A spicy flirt
videos.overview: Plutarco witnesses a misleading interaction between his wife and Carla. Connie shows Marta a legal precedent. Emiliano makes a life-changing decision.

videos.title: Speechless
videos.overview: When Emiliano's flight is delayed, he wonders if it's a sign. Benjamin tells Lucia he's turned over a new leaf. Connie runs into her former fiancé.

videos.title: Ashes of love
videos.overview: Max gets a potentially lucrative offer. Fernando and Isabel discuss their recent kiss. When Mariana misses class, a worried Daniel visits her home.

videos.title: Another covenant
videos.overview: The retreat has an effect on Connie and Plutarco. Pablo notices something has changed between Fernando and Isabel. Mariana's mom pays Emiliano a visit.

videos.title: Mirages
videos.overview: Luis receives a stunning delivery. Jimena holds a casting call to find a groom for Aurora. Max comes to a realization about Remedios — and himself.

videos.title: The blunder
videos.overview: Isabel faces a hurdle in her treatment. Worried about Daniel's safety, Mariana makes a decision. Max advises Remedios to not let a chance pass by.

videos.title: Like bees to honey
videos.overview: Pilar ignores her boss's advice about Luis. Max arrives in Miami. An attempt to make a grand gesture to win back Connie backfires on Plutarco.

videos.title: 50 days from the agreement
videos.overview: Los Bad Brothers hear their first produced track. Carlos mentions a fact about himself that makes Tere suspicious. Ivan announces a decision to Connie.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ivan's wife shows up at the law firm. A manhunt for Carlos begins. Marlene learns the truth behind Jimena and Aurora's unusual domestic arrangement.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Dulce asks Emiliano to meet her mother. Connie's parents invite Ivan over for dinner — at Connie's home. Remedios finds distraction in a new man.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Emiliano learns Remedios is seeing someone new. Connie's father goes missing. Plutarco receives an anonymous text message about the money Carlos stole.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Fernando tells Pablo of big changes in his life. Luis draws attention on social media. Plutarco learns Ivan wants Connie to buy an office next to his.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: When Connie and Ivan go to the opera, their children tag along. Alex begins his transitioning process. Vero becomes a bad influence on Daniel.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Max finds a confidant who has love problems similar to his own. Ivan presents a tempting offer to Remedios. A bombshell is dropped on Luis.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Alex gets fed up with being harassed by his football teammates. Daniel and Vero's misbehavior comes to light. Remedios sees another side of Erick.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Alex takes a big legal step as part of his transition. Luis attends a meeting for sex addicts. Ivan catches Connie and Plutarco sharing a cozy moment.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Remedios does some research on Erick. The school principal asks Max to fill in for an absent teacher. Connie and Plutarco get stuck in an elevator.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Luis tries to work his charms on Marlene. Pablo accepts his father's diagnosis and tells Connie. An idea occurs to Aurora while talking to Pilar.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Emiliano comes to Remedios' rescue. Isabel has a date with Max. Connie and Plutarco reconnect at the family cabin, where they're rudely interrupted.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jimena finds an excuse to see Ramiro again. Alex meets his online friend in person. Plutarco tries a different tack with real estate investor Martina.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: At the cabin, Connie and her friends face off against the demolition crew. Tania asks Alex for another chance. The diner's insurance report arrives.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: At the cabin, Plutarco and Connie find a surprise waiting for them. Mariana makes a bold move on Daniel. Things heat up between Max and Isabel.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Lucia sees Alex and Tania together and becomes jealous. Remedios proposes a racy idea to Emiliano. After a sleepover, Martin finds himself in hot water.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Remedios overhears Emiliano and Plutarco talking about marriage. The pills that Vero planted on Daniel go missing. A tenant moves into Ramiro's home.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Plutarco learns what Daniel has been up to. Pablo asks Fernando if he's really over Isabel. Alex and Tania take their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Remedios suspects her father is dating Mónica. When Alex is attacked at a park, an unlikely ally intervenes. Emiliano takes a big step.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Remedios finds out — in the worst possible way — who her father is dating. Before leaving for Rome, Connie receives an ominous warning from Vicky.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Plutarco takes advantage of Connie's absence. Ramiro asks Jimena if he can speak to her daughter. Alex has a difficult talk with Tania.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: In Rome, Connie comes to a realization. Vero blackmails Daniel with a revealing photo. Jimena catches Plutarco getting cozy with Elisa.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Plutarco decides to confess to Connie before she hears from Remedios and Jimena. Ramiro insists on riding out the storm in his auto repair shop.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Connie receives photo files on her cellphone from an unknown phone number. Pedro takes a sudden turn for the worse. Max finally sees a doctor.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Jimena and Tere plot to get rid of Elisa. Remedios starts her job as Dr. Barcenas' assistant. Luis comes up with an idea to keep his family together.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Plutarco responds to Elisa's proposal. Pedro returns home, but caring for him creates tension in his family. Alex gets worrying news from his coach.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Vero's mother delivers upsetting news to Daniel. Elisa's ex-husband pays a surprise visit. Jimena and Ramiro have a consultation with Dr. Barcenas.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Aurora makes a decision about her future. Connie catches Elisa canoodling with her ex. Dr. Barcenas and Emiliano go out for drinks after work.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Emiliano awakens to find Dr. Barcenas in his home, but can't remember the night before. Jimena is unable to keep the truth about Elisa from Plutarco.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Jimena fumes as Luis is inducted as the new PTA president. Connie sees more than she wants to on Plutarco's phone. Emiliano is reunited with an old pal.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: An upset Lucia asks Alex for a favor. Ramiro gives Remedios a surprise. When Jimena continues to struggle getting pregnant, Ramiro makes a suggestion.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Remedios suggests to Jimena and Ramiro another way they could have a child. Plutarco insists on moving back home. Connie and Sebastian start dating.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Fernando gives Pablo some news. Remedios gets evaluated to see if she can help Jimena and Ramiro. Emiliano makes a decision about Sebastian's job offer.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Connie and Plutarco learn Elisa is representing the opposing side in one of their cases. Julia asks Emiliano if he wants to continue their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Emiliano overhears Pablo sharing his and Remedios' plans with Fernando. Connie and Sebastian reconnect. Alex appears in the news and garners attention.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: The friends race to arrange a wedding in 24 hours. As Day 100 looms, Connie and Plutarco reminisce about the past months. Max gets a call from Miami.
